component.name: Zeidex Search
component.summary: Offline search, OCR and document AI

description.p: Zeidex Search is a launcher and a document studio in one window. It finds applications, files and folders as you type, keeps a local clipboard history, and evaluates arithmetic inline.
The document studio turns scans and PDFs into editable Word and Excel files using OCR that runs on this device. No account is required, nothing is uploaded, and there is no telemetry.
The interface is available in English and Arabic, including full right-to-left layout.

Arabic OCR re-reads low-confidence lines word by word (CER 15.57 % to 0.60 %), every file row carries its own format badge, the app can start with the system, and search reports whether a name matches at the start, the end, inside, or a typo away.
First packaged release: launcher, clipboard history, calculator, translation and the offline OCR studio.
